findings.title: Calculators hold value while Books drop steepest in Year 1
findings.detail: Across 200 seeded sales (seed 42), Calculators retain 55% of MRP on average because exam models stay identical, whereas Books fall to 44% in Year 1 alone as editions shift.

findings.title: Cycles care about Condition far more than Age
findings.detail: For Cycles, the resale gap between Like New and Worn is 43 percentage points of MRP—making brake/tire upkeep worth more than buying a newer year.

findings.title: Semester-start timing adds ~10–15% to resale price
findings.detail: Items sold during Jul–Aug or Dec–Jan semester rush clear at 47% average MRP retention, compared to 38% during the May move-out slump.
